commit_message: Preserve ACP MCP permission identity and terminal run state
pr_title: GameEngine: preserve ACP MCP permission identity
pr_body:
## Summary

- preserve provider-declared stable GameEngine MCP tool identity across ACP tool-call and permission events
- normalize claimed GameEngine MCP identities against the canonical Editor MCP inventory and shared read/write classifier while keeping malformed/unknown identities fail-closed
- distinguish Agent Host policy rejection from explicit user denial
- make provider turns terminal when completion gates remain unsatisfied so AI Studio cannot remain indefinitely Executing
- include regression coverage and ADR 0166 contract updates
- incorporate the prior Windows Validation diagnostics: test-only AcpPermissionOption import and rustfmt-normalized source

## Validation

Request Windows affected validation for the engine-editor scope. This changes ACP/Agent Host logic and documentation only; no visual-layout change is intended.

Supersedes Draft PR #1111, which was based on an older main baseline.
